examples.explanation: Removing the leading '1' gives "0200", normalized to "200".
Deleting everything leaves nothing, reported as "0".

hints: Build the answer left to right, discarding a previous larger digit whenever a smaller one arrives and deletions remain.
If deletions remain after the scan, drop from the right end.
Strip leading zeros at the end; an empty result means "0".
title: 476. Remove K Digits
